plan.title: Plan Your Visit
plan.arrival_text: Bamberg is on the ICE Munich–Berlin line. It's a 15-minute walk from the main station to the old town. Parking: avoid driving into the old town — use the station car parks (P1–P4).
plan.areas_text: Bamberg has two halves: the Hill Town (Domberg, Kaulberg) on the left Regnitz bank and the Island Town between the river arms. The Gardeners' Quarter is to the north. Everything is walkable, but the hills are real — 340 m of elevation for the full circuit.
plan.card_text: The Bamberg Card pays off at 3+ museums: free entry to all city museums and discounts at partner venues. Available at the World Heritage Centre.
plan.water_text: Bamberg's tap water is drinkable and excellent quality. You can order a free glass of tap water in restaurants — just ask for "Leitungswasser."
plan.hours_text: Bamberg museums are often closed on Mondays. Many churches are open during the day. Breweries have flexible hours — check their websites before visiting.
plan.hours_disclaimer: The hours listed here are not official and may change at any time. Please check the official website of each location before your visit.
